extracted.intended_audience: users and contributors of the mathlib4 Lean library (Lean theorem prover users, prospective code/documentation contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical and policy guidance for installing, building, documenting, and contributing code and documentation to the mathlib4 library for Lean 4. Includes required commands, documentation generation, dependency update policy, and community coordination steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Installation instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: You can find detailed instructions to install Lean, mathlib, and supporting tools on our website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the website installation guides; alternatively use the provided buttons to open a GitHub Codespace or a Gitpod workspace containing the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using mathlib4 as a dependency
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for using mathlib4 as a dependency are provided in the project wiki.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/wiki/Using-mathlib4-as-a-dependency for details on declaring and using mathlib4 from other projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Getting started / experimenting
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have Lean and mathlib4 installed, start with the tutorial project and other pointers under 'Learning Lean'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the tutorial project to learn the library; follow the Learning Lean pointers for additional onboarding resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation generation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The mathlib4 docs are documentation generated automatically from the source .lean files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The documentation set includes: the auto-generated mathlib4 docs, a description of currently covered theories and an overview for mathematicians, extra Lean documentation not specific to mathlib, and documentation aimed at prospective contributors. Maintain documentation in .lean source so it is picked up by the docs generator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributing documentation and process
rubrics_metrics.description: The complete documentation for contributing to mathlib is located in the community guide 'contribute to mathlib'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribe to the mathlib4 channel on Zulip to introduce yourself and your plan; community members can advise on fit and feasibility. Use the contribute guide as the canonical source for contribution process and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obtain precompiled olean files before building
rubrics_metrics.description: To obtain precompiled olean files, run 'lake exe cache get'. Skipping this step means the next step will be very slow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If something goes mysteriously wrong, try 'lake clean' or 'rm -rf .lake' before retrying 'lake exe cache get'. You can force re-download with 'lake exe cache get!'. Run 'lake exe cache' to see the help menu.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build and test workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: Build the library and run tests with lake commands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To build mathlib4 run 'lake build'. To build and run all tests run 'lake test'. To build a particular file use 'lake build Mathlib.Import.Path' (example: 'lake build Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Defs'). If you added a new file, run 'lake exe mk_all' to update Mathlib.lean.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style guide requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Mathlib has a style guide that must be followed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to the project's style guide for code and proof style; the style guide is listed under 'Guidelines' and is mandatory for contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Naming convention requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Mathlib enforces a naming convention that must be followed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the naming convention document referenced under 'Guidelines' when choosing names for declarations, lemmas, files, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation style requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Mathlib enforces a documentation style that must be followed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the documentation style guide listed under 'Guidelines' for docstrings, module docs, and other in-source documentation so docs generation is consistent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building HTML documentation (mathlib4_docs)
rubrics_metrics.description: The mathlib4_docs repository generates and publishes the mathlib4 HTML documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To build docs locally: git clone https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4_docs.git; cd mathlib4_docs; cp ../mathlib4/lean-toolchain .; run 'lake exe cache get'; then 'lake build Mathlib:docs'. The final step may take a while (>20 minutes). The generated HTML files are in .lake/build/doc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transitioning from Lean 3 / porting guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources are provided for Lean 3 users migrating to Lean 4 and for porting existing Lean 3 code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the 'survival guide' for Lean 3 users and the instructions to run 'mathport' on projects other than mathlib. Mathport was used by the community to port mathlib from Lean 3 to Lean 4.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dependency update policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are a mathlib contributor and want to update dependencies, use 'lake update' (or 'lake update batteries aesop' to update a subset).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using these commands will update lake-manifest.json correctly. After updating dependencies commit the changes and make a PR. Do not run 'lake update -Kdoc=on' — documentation-related dependencies should only be included when CI is building documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code of conduct and repository policies
rubrics_metrics.description: The repository contains a CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and other policy files which contributors are expected to follow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read and adhere to the code of conduct and contributing policy files (e.g., CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, CONTRIBUTING) linked from the README.
